text:
The most underrated AI skill isn't prompt engineering.

It's knowing when NOT to use AI.

I see founders automating things that:
• Take 5 minutes manually
• Need human judgment
• Are one-time tasks

AI isn't free.

Even when the API costs $0, there's cognitive overhead. Context switching. Maintenance.

The real skill: knowing which 10% to automate for 90% of the impact.

Everything else? Just do it yourself.
